title: MAMA Awards quiz: past Daesang winners and show facts
description: Ten sourced questions on the MAMA Awards: who won the big prizes in past years, and facts about the 2026 show on November 20 and 21.

sources.title: CJ Newsroom: 2026 MAMA Awards to take place in Japan from November 20-21 (March 31, 2026)
Wikipedia: MAMA Award for Artist of the Year (revision 1381566600)
Wikipedia: MAMA Award for Song of the Year (revision 1380497554)
Wikipedia: MAMA Award for Album of the Year (revision 1367080494)

questions.question: Who won Artist of the Year at the 2024 MAMA Awards?
questions.fun_fact: NewJeans won the award in 2023 and Seventeen followed in 2024.

questions.question: Which artist won MAMA Artist of the Year every year from 2016 to 2022?
questions.fun_fact: BTS took Artist of the Year seven years in a row, from 2016 to 2022.

questions.question: Which song won Song of the Year at the 2022 MAMA Awards?
questions.fun_fact: IVE won with Love Dive in 2022, NewJeans with Ditto in 2023 and aespa with Supernova in 2024.

questions.question: Which album won Album of the Year at the 2022 MAMA Awards?
questions.fun_fact: Proof by BTS won in 2022, after Be in 2021 and Map of the Soul: 7 in 2020.

questions.question: Which album won Album of the Year at the 2025 MAMA Awards?
questions.fun_fact: Stray Kids won Album of the Year in 2025 with Karma.

questions.question: Where are the 2026 MAMA Awards held?
questions.fun_fact: CJ ENM announced two days in Osaka, Japan, on November 20 and 21, 2026.

questions.question: In which year was the MAMA Awards first launched, according to CJ ENM?
questions.fun_fact: CJ ENM describes the first ceremony in 1999 as Korea's first music video ceremony.

questions.question: Which CJ ENM music channel first launched the MAMA Awards?
questions.fun_fact: Mnet is the music channel of CJ ENM, the company behind the MAMA Awards.

questions.question: In which year did the MAMA Awards take place in the United States for the first time?
questions.fun_fact: CJ ENM calls the 2024 edition in the United States a historic milestone.

questions.question: Which service streams the 2026 MAMA Awards live worldwide, according to CJ ENM?
questions.fun_fact: The 2026 edition carries the message Music Makes ONE.

notes: Facts read on 2026-11-09, re-checked 2026-11-09. Past winners from the Wikipedia revisions linked in the sources, show facts from the CJ newsroom.
